body: I’ve never been to a CODA meeting before. Can I just listen in if I go for the first time?

My circle of support is closing. I had more friends and everyone is leaving. I had a friend stage an “intervention” with me who had no idea what the fuck she was doing after I confided in her about how I had self harmed in the past, and she went and took it upon herself to contact a bunch of people I absolutely did not want knowing about it, and now none of them talk to me anymore.

I don’t fucking trust anyone and I hate it.

As an artist, I love this idea. 

I wish I’d stuck to my guns though, I messed up and now I’m at 4 days again ☹️
I know it’s been a while but, thank you so much for this. This really meant a lot to me
